summary: Three Lions Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its $100 million initial public offering. On September 2, 2026, the company sold 10,000,000 units at $10.00 each, each consisting of one ordinary share and one-half of one warrant exercisable at $11.50. The underwriter, EarlyBirdCapital, holds a 45-day over-allotment option for up to 1.5 million additional units. Proceeds are held in trust under an Investment Management Trust Agreement. The filing details standard SPAC agreements, including underwriting, warrant, and letter agreements. Watch for the initial business combination deadline and potential redemption risk.
